description: mta_sts_fetcher.rs uses response.chunk() in a loop with a running byte count rather than response.bytes() which would buffer the entire response before checking the size. A contributor might simplify this to .bytes().await and check len() afterward. That would allow an adversarial server to exhaust process memory before the limit fires. The chunk-by-chunk approach is correct and must be preserved. The comment already documents this reasoning.
title: chunk-by-chunk body reading in fetch_url prevents unbounded memory growth
